title: Q3 2026 Cobalt Price Review
gist: Cobalt prices fell broadly in Q3 2026 as resumed DRC exports flooded China with hydroxide: hydroxide (CIF Asia) fell 31% to $17.25/lb, sulphate (EXW China) nearly 30% to RMB 58,000/t, European metal ~11%, and MHP cobalt payables collapsed from 91.5% to 65.8%. Q4 hinges on whether the hydroxide bid-offer gap closes, post-Golden Week buying, and DRC customs/quota implementation.

themes.theme: DRC supply surge drives cobalt rout

insights.claim: Cobalt hydroxide prices (CIF Asia) fell 31% across Q3 2026 to $17.25/lb ($38,030/tonne) on increased DRC exports, per Benchmark's Cobalt Price Assessment.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Resumed DRC exports have flipped cobalt from scarcity to oversupply, hitting producer margins.
insights.quote: cobalt hydroxide prices (CIF Asia) falling 31% to across Q3 to $17.25/lb ($38,030/tonne)

insights.claim: Cobalt sulphate prices (EXW China) dropped nearly 30% in Q3 2026 to RMB 58,000/tonne ($8,642).
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Battery-grade cobalt chemical prices have reset sharply lower, easing NCM cathode input costs.

insights.claim: EXW Europe cobalt metal prices eased about 11% in Q3 2026, a far smaller decline than hydroxide or sulphate.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Metal lagged intermediates, suggesting regional/form dislocations in the cobalt complex.

insights.claim: Benchmark's senior cobalt analyst attributes Q3's broad price decline to rising DRC-origin supply following on from the weak downstream buying that defined Q2.
insights.speaker: George Ingall
insights.so_what: Both supply and demand drivers turned bearish in sequence, compounding the downturn.
insights.quote: rising DRC-origin supply succeeded the weak downstream buying that defined Q2

insights.claim: DRC cobalt hydroxide imports into China exceeded 10,000 tonnes in June 2026 versus roughly 2,000 tonnes in May, confirming the recovery in material flow anticipated at end-Q2.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A ~5x month-on-month jump in imports signals the DRC export restriction effect has largely unwound.
insights.quote: DRC hydroxide imports into China exceeding 10,000 tonnes in June compared with roughly 2,000 tonnes in May

insights.claim: DRC customs processes and quota implementation remain a swing factor for cobalt inflows into China heading into Q4 2026.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Policy execution in the DRC is the key upside risk to cobalt prices.
insights.quote: DRC customs processes and quota implementation remain a swing factor for inflows into China

insights.claim: Benchmark's daily cobalt hydroxide assessment dropped to $22.50/lb in early August and held there because no trades were confirmed in the ten days to 26 August.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Illiquid markets mean quoted prices may lag true clearing levels.
insights.quote: no trades were confirmed in the ten days to 26 August

insights.claim: Benchmark's weekly cobalt hydroxide index, which incorporates bids, offers and sentiment during low liquidity, fell over 11% week-on-week to $17.50/lb in mid-August.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Sentiment-based indices moved faster than transacted prices, signalling deeper weakness.

insights.claim: The cobalt hydroxide market fell into a stalemate as sellers refused to transact below $20.00/lb while buyers, holding adequate inventory against a soft battery order book, saw no reason to chase.
insights.speaker: George Ingall
insights.so_what: Buyer inventory cover plus weak battery orders give buyers pricing power.
insights.quote: sellers unwilling to transact below $20.00/lb while buyers, holding adequate inventory against a soft battery order book, saw no reason to chase

insights.claim: A key Q4 2026 watchpoint is whether trades finally cross the cobalt hydroxide bid-offer gap and whether buyers return after Golden Week.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: A resolution of the standoff will set the true clearing price for cobalt intermediates.
insights.quote: whether trades finally cross the hydroxide bid-offer gap, and whether buyers return once Golden Week ends

themes.theme: Sulphate leads decline as recyclers discount

insights.claim: Cobalt sulphate held between RMB 80,000 and 85,000/tonne through most of July on stable NCM demand before rising hydroxide arrivals pulled it down 2.4% on 29 July.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Sulphate's stability broke only once feedstock supply arrived, showing supply-led price discovery.

insights.claim: Recyclers discounted cobalt sulphate units, driving a 6.7% week-on-week drop to RMB 70,000/tonne ($10,432) on 26 August as buyers held out ahead of pre-Golden Week stockpiling.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Recycled supply is now a meaningful marginal price-setter in cobalt chemicals.

insights.claim: Cobalt sulphate declined every week in September 2026, reaching RMB 58,000/tonne on 30 September.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Uninterrupted weekly declines indicate no floor yet established entering Q4.
insights.quote: Sulphate declined every week in September to RMB 58,000/tonne on 30 September.

insights.claim: Further recycler discounting in cobalt sulphate is flagged as a Q4 2026 risk factor.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Continued recycler selling could extend sulphate weakness.

themes.theme: MHP payables and metal follow lower

insights.claim: CIF Asia MHP cobalt payables sank from 91.5% to 65.8% by mid-September 2026 because cheaper cobalt hydroxide offered buyers an alternative.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Indonesian MHP producers lose cobalt by-product revenue when DRC hydroxide is abundant.
insights.quote: CIF Asia MHP cobalt payables sank from 91.5% to 65.8% by mid September

insights.claim: Downstream buyers viewed 91% MHP cobalt payables as too high in July, and payables sank as the gap with cheaper hydroxide widened.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Substitution between cobalt feedstocks transmits DRC supply shocks into Indonesian MHP economics.
insights.quote: Downstream buyers viewed 91% payables as too high in July

insights.claim: European cobalt metal held above $25.00/lb through August because elevated hydroxide feedstock costs made extra production unviable, before easing as weak demand caught up.
insights.speaker: Benchmark Team
insights.so_what: Metal prices respond to feedstock costs with a lag, so further metal weakness may follow cheaper hydroxide.
insights.quote: European metal held above $25.00/lb through August
